# Assessment workspace core

These modules provide local SQLite records, retained source files, record revisions, named staff credentials and private backup for the GovHub operator. The public projection removes internal coordination locators from the assessment criteria; the complete storage implementation and public primary-source references remain present.

Run the application from its enclosing workspace directory. Keep this source separate from private editable workspaces and supplied inputs. The complete application source lock identifies the exact current bytes of both modules and the cutover auditor at the application root. Changes to source metadata do not change existing saved records or workspace identities.
